what_makes_it_work: A numbered 'mistakes' list with a cover that names the count, plus mid-carousel keyword pills that each offer a concrete free item (hunger-cue list, lamp link). It has 1033 likes and 748 comments, so the comment keywords seem to be pulling people in.
lumebook_takeaway: Put a free, specific offer in a pill on the slides where the topic naturally calls for it (not only on the last slide), and ask for one keyword per offer.
